I'm a creative and enthusiastic BBA student who loves digital marketing, content creation and graphic design. I work with Canva every day to make posters, thumbnails and social media posts, and I edit short videos for Reels and Shorts.

I also use AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google Flow to write, plan and produce images and videos faster. I also design and develop websites with AI website builders.

My goal is simple: help brands grow online with content people enjoy, while I keep learning from real industry work.
